description.short: Find skills (capabilities) an agent can call inside this org.
description.full: Read-only discovery over the org's skills registry. Lets a Cowork agent ask 'who can do X?' (find_skill_by_capability), 'what can this org do?' (list_capabilities), and 'tell me everything about this skill' (describe_skill). Each result includes the MCP binding the agent needs to call the underlying skill server.

agentConnectors.description: Read-only discovery tools over the org's skills registry. find_skill_by_capability, describe_skill, list_capabilities.
